youtube_title: Kadhai Oil on Fire: Throw Water or Cover With a Lid? Brave vs Normal #13 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #13. The oil in the kadhai catches fire. Brave wants to throw water on it. Normal turns the gas off and slides a lid over it. Comment B or N!
Answer: NORMAL. Never put water on burning oil - it turns to steam and throws the burning oil out as a fireball. Turn the gas off if it's safe, slide a lid over the pan, don't move it and keep it covered till it cools. If the fire grows, get everyone out and call the fire service (101).
Sources: NFPA cooking safety; Essex and West Sussex Fire & Rescue Services.
